scope: repository and Baota release-task security gate; no production runtime API, table, page, permission or daemon

notApplicable.databaseMigration: The gate reads repository and runtime evidence and persists only ignored verification reports.
notApplicable.runtimeApi: Release verification is never exposed through a production HTTP route.
notApplicable.frontendPage: The gate validates all existing pages and does not add a user-facing security result page.
notApplicable.asyncRuntime: It runs as a finite local, CI, or Baota-controlled release task, never as a Worker, Crawler, Outbox consumer, or daemon.
